description: This file defines the AsyncPipeline class, a utility for controlling the rate of asynchronous operations, including capacity management, queuing, and synchronization mechanisms, primarily used for stress-testing and load control in asynchronous environments.

classes.name: AsyncPipeline
classes.description: A utility class that manages a pipeline of asynchronous tasks, controlling concurrency and providing back-pressure mechanisms.

classes.name: AsyncPipeline.WhiteBox
classes.description: A nested class used for internal testing and inspection of the pipeline's state.

methods.name: AsyncPipeline
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pipeline with default capacity or a specified capacity.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a task to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddRange
methods.description: Adds multiple tasks to the pipeline from a collection.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until all enqueued tasks are completed.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Internal method to add a task with optional whitebox testing context.

methods.name: OnTaskCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked when a task completes to update internal state.

methods.name: UnblockWaiting
methods.description: Unblocks waiting tasks when capacity allows.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the WhiteBox for testing purposes.
